auth.title: Sign in to CampusDesk
auth.safeNotice: The safe variant sends the same payload so you can verify that the backend blocks injection.
auth.unsafeNotice: The unsafe variant inserts input directly into its authentication query. Use only the synthetic payloads and data for this demonstration.

lab.pageDescription: Operate the login form yourself, then inspect diagnostics and authentication events.
lab.safeExplanation: The query only finds the username; the password is independently verified with scrypt.
lab.unsafeSqlExplanation: The unsafe variant concatenates input into SQL. A payload string can alter the syntax and query condition to bypass password verification.
lab.unsafeMongoExplanation: The unsafe variant passes input directly into the query. A custom JSON object can replace the password condition; ordinary strings are still compared as values.
lab.rejectedExplanation: Validation blocked the request before the authentication query. The session and audit log may still use the database.
lab.appDescription: Application-flow description; this is not a database trace.
lab.emptyDiagnostic: Choose a payload and send the request. The result comes from the real database, not a browser-side simulation.

demo.title: Manual demonstration guide
demo.description: Enter each payload yourself in the existing login form. This page does not run scenarios for you.
demo.manualDescription: Enter a payload and send each request yourself to the connected {{engine}} database. Use DevTools to inspect the request, HTTP response, and CampusDesk data.
demo.manualStepOne: On the login page, choose Injection demo, enter a username, and type the payload yourself. Use the same input on the unsafe and safe variants.
demo.manualStepTwo: Submit once and inspect the dashboard; open Network to view POST /api/auth/login and GET /api/dashboard and /api/tickets.
demo.manualStepThree: Use separate browser profiles or windows for user and admin. Compare request lists, the Users page, and 403/401 responses.
demo.manualStepFour: An admin can change a request status or lock a student account to show impact; the Users page has a button to restore the seeded records.
demo.manualScope: Login requests use the real database for that variant and its synthetic accounts and requests. Restore only updates the 3 seeded accounts and 12 seeded requests; it does not delete user-created records, sessions, or audit events.
demo.resetConfirm: Restore the 3 seeded accounts and 12 seeded requests? Other records, sessions, and audit events will be preserved.
demo.resetSuccess: Restored the 3 seeded accounts and 12 seeded requests. Other records, sessions, and audit events were preserved.
demo.resetScope: Reset restores only admin-001, user-001, user-002, and ticket-001 through ticket-012. It does not delete added accounts/requests, sessions, or audit events.

demo.sqlDefense: Use a parameterized query to find the account, then verify the password independently.
demo.mongoDefense: Require both username and password to be strings. Use a fixed filter structure and verify the password independently.

ownership.title: Request read access
ownership.instruction: Open the request list as a student. It should show only that account's requests. The API test confirms another student's request returns HTTP 403.

admin.title: Admin actions and profile edits
admin.instruction: Update a request as an administrator, then reopen it as its owner to see the new status. API tests confirm students cannot change status, create accounts, or change their role through the profile.

session.title: Sessions and account locking
session.instruction: Open another variant to check session isolation. API tests confirm an old session loses access after logout or when its account is locked.

apostrophe.title: Valid text with an apostrophe
apostrophe.instruction: Save and reopen a title such as Request from O'Connor. Confirm that the apostrophe is preserved.

disclosure.title: Out-of-scope record disclosure
disclosure.request: View a request from Group A.
disclosure.defense: Scope results to the signed-in account and return only the fields needed for display.

targeted-update.title: Out-of-scope record update
targeted-update.defense: Check authorization for each record and constrain the update scope.

bulk-update.title: Unexpected bulk update
bulk-update.defense: Use a fixed condition based on ID and owner; check affected rows.

bulk-delete.title: Deleting multiple records
bulk-delete.defense: Limit the action by permission and record ID; run it on temporary sandbox data.

table-loss.title: Dropping a table or collection
table-loss.defense: Destructive operations target only the temporary table or collection for this run.

privilege.title: Changing privileges through a data update
privilege.request: Change the display name of a sample account.
privilege.defense: Accept only permitted profile fields; change roles through an authorized admin flow.

error-details.title: Information disclosed in error messages
error-details.request: Submit a value with an invalid format.
error-details.defense: Return a concise error to users without exposing driver details.

response-difference.title: Information leaked through different responses
response-difference.request: Compare responses for two hypothetical cases.
response-difference.defense: Keep public responses consistent when differences could disclose data.

authentication.title: Authentication with an incorrect password
authentication.request: Attempt to sign in with an incorrect password.
authentication.defense: Find accounts with a constrained query and verify the password independently.

mongo-types.title: Data types in MongoDB authentication
mongo-types.request: Compare an object, JSON string, array, null, number, and correct password.
mongo-types.defense: Accept passwords only as strings and reject invalid types before authentication.

ticket-ownership.title: Student request ownership
ticket-ownership.request: Have a Group A student open their own request, then compare it with a Group B request.
ticket-ownership.defense: Check record ownership on the server for every request.

role-boundaries.title: Restricted actions and role fields
role-boundaries.request: Compare a student's ability to change status, create accounts, and update a profile.
role-boundaries.defense: Check the user's role on the server before each administrative operation.

session-boundaries.title: Session isolation, logout, and account locking
session-boundaries.request: Compare profile access on another variant, after logout, and while the account is locked.
session-boundaries.defense: Check variant, session state, and account state on the server.

legitimate-apostrophe.title: Valid text containing an apostrophe
legitimate-apostrophe.request: Save and reopen a request titled Request from O'Connor.
legitimate-apostrophe.defense: Use parameters or BSON fields to preserve apostrophes.
